# Kuhi Anime & Manga Studio API - LLM & AI Agent Specification

> This document is designed for AI assistants, LLMs, and autonomous agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot) to build applications using the Kuhi Anime & Manga Studio API.

## API Overview & Base URL
- **Base URL:** `http://localhost:5646` (Local) / `https://anime-and-manwhua.vercel.app` (Production)
- **CORS:** Enabled (`*`) on all endpoints.
- **Authentication:** Required for `/api/anime/*`, `/api/manga/*`, and `/api/releases`.
  - Query Parameter: `?key=YOUR_API_KEY`
  - HTTP Header: `X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY`
  - Bearer Token: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`
  - Default Demo Key: `kuhi_live_27f453e42c851403fac890ac7d1cc803`

---

## 1. Release Tracking Endpoints (New & Recommended)

### 1.1 Unified Release Tracking Hub
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/releases`
- **Query Parameters:**
  - `type` (string, required): `anime` or `manga`
  - `id` (string, required): AniList ID for anime (e.g. `21`) or Slug/ID for manga (e.g. `the-rebel-of-the-apocalypse-academy`)
  - `source` (string, optional, default `vortex`): `vortex`, `mangadex`, or `auto`
  - `include_pages` (boolean, optional, default `false`): Include panel images for manga
  - `chapter` (string, optional): Target chapter (`latest`, `unlocked`, `first`, or number)
  - `sub_or_dub` (string, optional, default `sub`): Audio type for anime

### 1.2 Anime Release Tracker & Episode Count
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/anime/releases/{anime_id}`
- **Query Parameters:** `type` (sub/dub), `key`
- **Response Shape:**
  ```json
  {
    "id": 21,
    "mal_id": 21,
    "title": "ONE PIECE",
    "title_english": "One Piece",
    "status": "RELEASING",
    "is_airing": true,
    "released_episodes_count": 1180,
    "total_expected_episodes": null,
    "next_airing": {
      "episode": 1181,
      "airing_at_timestamp": 1798985760,
      "time_until_airing_seconds": 6979800,
      "countdown": "80d 18h 50m"
    },
    "poster": "https://s4.anilist.co/file/anilistcdn/media/anime/cover/large/bx21-ELSYx3yMPcKM.jpg",
    "banner": "https://s4.anilist.co/file/anilistcdn/media/anime/banner/21-wf37VakJmZqd.jpg",
    "latest_released_episode": {
      "number": 1180,
      "title": "Episode 1180",
      "player_url": "http://localhost:5646/player?id=21&episode=1180&key=YOUR_KEY",
      "iframe_embed": "<iframe src=\"http://localhost:5646/player?id=21&episode=1180&key=YOUR_KEY\" width=\"100%\" height=\"100%\" frameborder=\"0\" allowfullscreen></iframe>"
    },
    "episodes": [
      {
        "number": 1,
        "title": "Episode 1",
        "thumbnail": "https://...",
        "player_url": "http://localhost:5646/player?id=21&episode=1&key=YOUR_KEY",
        "iframe_embed": "<iframe src=\"...\" ...></iframe>"
      }
    ]
  }
  ```

### 1.3 Manga Release Tracker & Chapter Panels
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/manga/releases/{slug_or_id}`
- **Query Parameters:**
  - `source` (string, optional, default `vortex`): `vortex`, `mangadex`, or `auto`
  - `include_pages` (boolean, optional, default `false`): Include panel images
  - `chapter` (string, optional): `latest` (default), `unlocked`, `first`, or chapter number e.g. `15`
  - `limit` (int, optional, default `250`): Max chapters in list
  - `key` (string, required)
- **Response Shape:**
  ```json
  {
    "id": "695",
    "title": "The Rebel of the Apocalypse Academy",
    "slug": "the-rebel-of-the-apocalypse-academy",
    "type": "MANHWA",
    "source": "vortex",
    "status": "RELEASING",
    "released_chapters_count": 16,
    "poster": "https://s4.anilist.co/file/anilistcdn/media/manga/cover/medium/b167759-Uqb92EWWE3pp.jpg",
    "latest_released_chapter": { "id": "34023", "number": "20", "is_locked": true },
    "latest_unlocked_chapter": { "id": "34018", "number": "15", "is_locked": false },
    "first_released_chapter": { "id": "34010", "number": "1", "is_locked": false },
    "chapter_panels": {
      "chapter_id": "34018",
      "number": "15",
      "pages_count": 32,
      "reader_url": "http://localhost:5646/manga/reader/34018?source=vortex&key=YOUR_KEY",
      "iframe_embed": "<iframe src=\"http://localhost:5646/manga/reader/34018?source=vortex&key=YOUR_KEY\" width=\"100%\" height=\"800\" frameborder=\"0\" allowfullscreen></iframe>",
      "pages": [
        {
          "page": 1,
          "url": "http://localhost:5646/proxy_image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fstorage.vortexscans.org%2Fupload%2F...webp&referer=https%3A%2F%2Fvortexscans.org%2F",
          "raw_url": "https://storage.vortexscans.org/upload/...webp"
        }
      ]
    },
    "chapters": [ ... ]
  }
  ```

---

## 2. Anime Video & Built-in Player Endpoints

### 2.1 Get Built-in Player & Embed Code
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/anime/player`
- **Query Parameters:** `id` (int, required), `episode` (int, default 1), `type` (sub/dub), `server`, `key`
- **Returns:** Standalone `player_url` and iframe snippet with horizontal hover volume slider, 10s skip buttons, AniSkip button at `bottom: 85px`, and yellow seekbar markers.

### 2.2 Direct Stream Extraction (CORS Proxied)
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/anime/stream`
- **Query Parameters:** `id`, `episode`, `type`, `key`
- **Returns:** Video streams pre-proxied through `/proxy_mp4` or `/proxy_m3u8` to avoid 403 Forbidden / CORS errors.

### 2.3 Standalone Web Player Page
- **URL:** `/player?id={anime_id}&episode={episode}&key={key}`
- **Features:** Ready for direct browser embedding (`<iframe>`).

---

## 3. Manga, Manhwa & Manhua Endpoints

### 3.1 Search Manga / Manhwa / Manhua
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/manga/search`
- **Query Parameters:** `q`, `type` (`all`, `manhwa`, `manga`, `manhua`), `source`, `page`, `key`
- **Returns:** Deduplicated multi-source titles enriched with official AniList HD covers.

### 3.2 Manga Details & Chapters
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/manga/info/{slug_or_id}`
- **Query Parameters:** `source` (`vortex`, `mangadex`), `key`

### 3.3 Chapter Panel Pages
- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/manga/chapter/{chapter_id}`
- **Query Parameters:** `source`, `key`
- **Returns:** Array of panel images formatted with `/proxy_image` for safe embedding in any web or mobile app.

### 3.4 Standalone Webtoon Reader
- **URL:** `/manga/reader/{chapter_id}?source={source}&key={key}`
- **Features:** Continuous vertical strip reader with dark theme, keyboard navigation (`Left`/`Right`), and fullscreen mode (`F`).

---

## 4. Quick Agent Implementation Recipes

### Recipe A: Query Latest Anime Release & Embed Video
```javascript
// Step 1: Query release status
const res = await fetch(`https://anime-and-manwhua.vercel.app/api/anime/releases/21?key=kuhi_live_27f453e42c851403fac890ac7d1cc803`);
const data = await res.json();

// Step 2: Display latest episode
console.log(`Latest Episode: ${data.latest_released_episode.number}`);
document.getElementById('player').innerHTML = data.latest_released_episode.iframe_embed;
```

### Recipe B: Query Manga Chapter Count & Render Panels
```javascript
// Step 1: Query manga release info with panels
const res = await fetch(`https://anime-and-manwhua.vercel.app/api/manga/releases/the-rebel-of-the-apocalypse-academy?include_pages=true&key=kuhi_live_27f453e42c851403fac890ac7d1cc803`);
const data = await res.json();

// Step 2: Render panels
data.chapter_panels.pages.forEach(p => {
  const img = document.createElement('img');
  img.src = p.url; // Pre-proxied CORS-safe URL
  document.getElementById('manga-container').appendChild(img);
});
```
